name: Octree Construction from Structured Volumes
definition: Generation of an octree from a 3D grid by consolidating voxels with zero inter-voxel variance, extending the principle of quadtree generation from 2D grids by consolidating pixels with zero inter-pixel variance.
summary: Octree Construction from Structured Volumes compresses large 3D scalar grids into adaptive-resolution octrees by consolidating voxels with zero inter-voxel variance, offering finer granularity than methods that encapsulate eight-voxel cells.
